method: Read-only per-frame native trace of the recorded winning route (evidence/local/native-trace-winning-route-ram-20261109.jsonl, decoded player position, engine, mode and task bytes; no ROM inspection). For every area-changing pipe in 1-2, 2-2, 4-2, 7-2 and 8-4 the last control row (engine 8) to the first load row (task 0) is the entering animation, task 0-2 is the load/black screen, and engine 7 after the load is the locked rise out of the destination pipe. Row counts are identical in all 8 observed pipes of each kind.
loadFramesNote: 25 load rows (task 0-2) plus the first playable row, which still shows engine 0 at the origin before the rise starts; control then returns 96 rows later (174 = 52+25+1+96 right, 170 = 48+25+1+96 down).

rise.note: Native player y runs 240 -> 144 (sprite top) at one pixel per frame from the first playable row, i.e. feet 272 -> 176 = the spawn feet of these rooms; control (engine 8) starts on the row the spawn height is reached.

entryTrigger: entryTriggerX (right pipes): player x at which the entering animation starts while holding right on the ground, bracketed by the last engine-8 and first engine-2 rows; in all five pipes it equals the pipe's left edge (his stopping position) minus 13: Mario walks 12-13 px to the edge (1-2 2656, 2-2 3024, 4-2 2992, 7-2 3024, 8-4 1088). The screenshot-era 1-2 and 4-2 maps had their pipes 16 px too far right, which read as 'wall - 29'. The remake's older window |x+14-pipe.x|<3 started it up to 46 px late.
